status: Fixed before this full-sample run; explicitly post-development, not prospective preregistration
question: How do conditional CES-D8 symptom-response probability contrasts between hearing-screen groups depend on measurement structure and anchor assumptions?
design: Cross-sectional complete-case measurement study; not a hearing-aid treatment or causal study
original_primary_structure: M2: correlated affective (i1,i4,i5,i6,i7) and somatic (i2,i3,i8) factors; retain original literature-led primary structural candidate
auxiliary_structure: M1R: general factor and i4/i6 residual covariance; supported alternative, not chosen by coverage or fit ranking
main_analysis: Report both full 30-anchor grids. M2 is structural main reference; no single anchor is a verified primary invariant set.

reference_anchor.selection: First enumerated balanced set, also used in synthetic method evaluation. Fixed now for transparent auxiliary display after prior real results were seen; not a validated hearing-invariant anchor.

anchor_grid: All 30 combinations of two affective and two somatic anchors; no selection by p value, fit or desirable sign
sample_definition: Unchanged frozen loader: core personal interview age50+; consistent bilateral screening; all CES-D8 complete; valid household/GOR; positive finite W7XWGT
hearing_definition: O1 neither ear heard all three 3kHz tones; O0 at least one ear heard all three; screening classification, not clinical normal/hearing-loss diagnosis
missingness: No imputation; retain frozen complete-case domain and all positive-weight households with zero estimating contribution outside domain; no new exclusion based on model results
partition: Use full7314 to estimate exploratory contrasts. Previous4380/2934 both inspected; pooled analysis is neither external validation nor prospective confirmation.
estimation: Unchanged DWLS theta probit; sampling.weights.type=design; weights normalized within hearing group; fixed weights; anchor thresholds/loadings equal; free latent location/scale in O1
estimand: For every non-anchor j: delta_j=Phi(-t1/sqrt(1+a1^2))-Phi(-t0/sqrt(1+a0^2)), common standard-normal reference. Different structures have different latent coordinates; do not pool them.
outputs: 240 non-anchor common-reference contrasts if all fits admissible
M1R AS01 four auxiliary intervals and Holm p, with lexical-tie SE sensitivity

inference.scope: Auxiliary M1R AS01 only, conditional and exploratory; no M2 SE/CI, no anchor-grid range confidence intervals
inference.covariance: Frozen objective-consistent expected-information/Gauss-Newton delta method, correct model and fixed anchors; not misspecification robust
inference.design: Entire positive-weight household skeleton centered within GOR; with-replacement approximation, finite H/(H-1) correction, no FPC or re-estimated survey weights
inference.tie_sensitivity: lex_last changes only assignment of3 mixed-GOR households/6people; identical fitted parameters, no refit
inference.p_values: two-sided t; Holm n=4 across i5-i8 separately for baseline and tie sensitivity. Does not correct prior model/anchor selection; no confirmatory label or significance-based selection.
inference.failures: If any reference SE invalid, preserve reason and suppress the four-item interval table; no alternate anchor substitution

numerical_rules: Retain unchanged fit_conditional convergence, postcheck, positive slopes, covariance eigenvalues>1e-8, loading/rho and rank gates. Same gate for all60.
descriptive_fit: Report moment residuals without automatic model switching or data-driven residual paths. Descriptive adequacy does not prove correct structure or anchors.
grid_summary: For each structure/item, report min/median/max and signs only when all planned18 affective or10 somatic non-anchor fits are available; otherwise mark incomplete, retain all failures.
stop_rule: Exactly60 fixed calls, no replacement/retry, no outcome-driven additions; technical failures preserve intents, require diagnosis. Data/count/hash mismatch stops before fitting.
history: Old19/24 calibration unchanged; bootstrap-t availability failure retained; new2000 M1R_null provides conditional support but not automatic whole-study validation; old two500 i5 low-coverage batches also retained.
privacy: Local authorized archive, participant rows only in RAM/local stdin; opaque HH codes to R, no source person IDs, no participant/latent-score/model-object exports or remote transfer.

sources.role: Primary ELSA CES-D8 structure paper; gender/longitudinal analyses do not certify hearing anchors
Official R documentation for Holm p adjustment; not validation of underlying conditional p values
